remarks:
UPDATE: APPROXIMATELY 1,728 SQ. FT. OF LIVING SPACE! Square footage is based on a licensed 2020 appraisal. Public records differ.
Welcome to your private country retreat on 3 picturesque acres! This custom built ranch, completed in 2017, offers quality craftsmanship, peaceful surroundings, and exceptional versatility for hobby farmers, equestrians, outdoor enthusiasts, or anyone seeking country living.

The home features 2 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, a spacious open-concept layout, custom built cabinetry with dovetail drawers, beautiful copper sinks in both the kitchen and full bath, a whole-house UV water purification system, and an under-sink reverse osmosis system. The primary bedroom offers a spacious walk-in closet, while the full bathroom features both a relaxing jetted soaking tub and a separate stand-up shower. Stay comfortable year-round with electric heat and the warmth of a wood stove. The septic system was pumped approximately three years ago, and a new garage door has recently been installed.

Outside, the property is fully fenced and ready for animals with a 28’ x 48’ barn built in 2020, complete with horse stalls, ample storage, and a spacious second-level loft offering endless possibilities for storage, a workshop, or future finishing. A nearby machine shed (workshop) includes electricity, full insulation, a wood stove, and a generator hookup for added convenience. A new black wood fence is currently being installed along the driveway to match the existing fencing.

Located walking distance from Bear Lake and near Stockton State Forest, you’ll enjoy easy access to snowmobile trails, hiking, horseback riding, hunting, fishing, and year-round outdoor recreation.

Whether you’re looking for a hobby farm, horse property, homestead, or simply a peaceful place to call home, 8202 Bear Lake Road offers the perfect blend of craftsmanship, functionality, and country charm.
